tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Behavior (form-token store, existing route commit points, instanceName wiring, script route and metrics); Decisions 1, 6 and 11; Required behavior 1a and 2 (first live shell/sign-out integration); Checks 7 (asset/security headers), 7a, 7c and 9; Rule for the existing test files including item 3 (withoutCsrf also strips form_token, equality assertion unchanged); Counterexamples (form-token store, full-store isolation, sign-in replay through sign-out without session, script route, frozen HTML). Implement the entire token-store algorithm with the separate 2000 anonymous and 8000 signed-in pools and commit-point enforcement on all existing account forms. Replace landingPage with the shell and retained API-origin line so sign-out has its session-bound token; Overview reads and the common protected dispatcher arrive in T4. acceptance.expected: 0 fail in the focused tests; a coverage-only nonzero exit is not a test failure. A token is 43 base64url characters from 32 random bytes, accepted once then replayed; wrong binding/path, unknown and empty are invalid. It is accepted at issuedAt + 43_199_999 and invalid at +43_200_000. The 101st unused token evicts the first of that binding, not the second. Used entries remain replayed until expiry/eviction; wasUsed is false before use, true afterward on the same path, false on another path and at expiry. With 8000 s: tokens (80 sessions x 100) and 2000 a: tokens, one more a: invalidates only the oldest a: and leaves the oldest s: accepted; one more s: from an 81st session invalidates only the oldest s: and leaves the second a: accepted. With 8000 s: and 0 a:, issuing one a: leaves all 8000 s: valid. Oldest means issuedAt then insertion order; the total never exceeds 10000, with no eviction across pools.
